title: Veil-rays at Hamal Crystal Bloom; verdigris curd sold at Node Gamma
note: Seven kills in 33 minutes with a Pulse Laser I (2026-11-15). A carcass holds 1 or 2 curd. Curd bids: 330 cr. The first measured run is too high: its 9 curd included carcasses an earlier, unrecorded hunt had left here. The clean run at GSC-0027 gave about 4,200 cr per ship-hour.
